headline.title: 中国罕见盘中表态支持市场，股市创2024年以来最大涨幅
headline.summary: 中国有关部门罕见在盘中发布支持市场的声明，推动股市创2024年以来最大涨幅，并录得两年多来最佳单日表现。
headline.title_en: China Spurs Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 on Rare Midday Vow
headline.summary_en: Chinese authorities issued a rare midday statement pledging market support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years and the biggest gain since 2024.
